{{short description|Indian physicist (born 1971)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2019}}
'''Pratap Raychaudhuri''' (born 13 December 1971) is an Indian physicist who works at [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]], [[Mumbai|Bombay]]. His specialization is in the fields of [[superconductivity]] and [[magnetism]], transport based spectroscopy, and thin films.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=502 |title=Awardee Details: Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |publisher=Ssbprize.gov.in |date=1971-12-13 |accessdate=2015-11-26}}</ref>  He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]] in 2014.<ref>{{cite web|title=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar awards for 10 scientists |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/states/shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-awards-for-10-scientists/article6450071.ece |publisher=BusinessLine |date=26 September 2014 |accessdate=28 September 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. P.S.Ahuja Announces Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2014 |url=http://pib.nic.in/newsite/erelease.aspx?relid=110063 |publisher=Dr. P.S.Ahuja Announces Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2014 |date=26 September 2014|accessdate=28 September 2014}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web| title=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science & Technology 2014 | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/WriteReadData/LatestUpdates/201409260153504671808ssb_awardees2014.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006130418/http://ssbprize.gov.in/WriteReadData/LatestUpdates/201409260153504671808ssb_awardees2014.pdf | archive-date=2014-10-06}}</ref>
